summary: A reasonable bid to beat the board: it restacks the router PDL change (routed in all four classes) and adds the pooled-IQR khalf rule; the parent patch applies to the same base blob and breaks no rule. One run cannot read the headline (~+0.5% vs CI ~1.5%): judge on the R-PDL and K PATH CHOSEN lines and the judged rows. The khalf half is the same routing rule the queued control khalf-gate-three-rounds-pooled-control-gate-stats-pooled-iqr implements: fold that control's diagnostic in here or run them in sequence.
justification: Router PDL is real: gates passed in all four classes, the nopdl arm equals master, the race checks are clean and the no-wait control was wrong 32/32 times. Judged rows only partly agree vs three master-lineage runs: m=16 5.27 vs 5.48-5.73 (~-0.36 us, clear); m=128 7.06 vs 7.39-7.95 (likely); m=32 5.96 vs 5.94-6.10 (flat despite ~0.4 us at the gate); m=256 9.06 inside master's spread: ~0.6-1.0 us summed, ~0.2-0.3% headline. Khalf: the IQR clause binds (>= 5 of 10 logged rounds failed it), but a20f8048 r1 was 1.027 (< 1.03), so that miss was ratio and IQR. Weakest link: the candidate is genuinely wider (summed IQRs cand/master ~1.42 vs a 1.5 bar), so a 123-rep pooled test at 1.5x is near a coin flip (~55-70%). Median-of-3 >= 1.03 passes ~90%. 'layer=router *' is too broad: m=1/8 take the untouched cluster path.
confounders: 8f233e88 (read-flush gates + khalf b2): R-PDL classes are themselves marginal (m=128 r1 1.031): read FINAL FLAGS before any row.
pooler-nn-layout-widen-m256 / restack-three-cell-wins: the khalf master side's IQR (0.45-0.90 us) and the 0.5 us floor set the bar.
router hilo / swapab designs are preconditions; the flat judged m=32 row suggests less of the fill is hidden there.
router_kernel<8,8> at m<=8: m=1/8 rows cannot move.
bulk12 m=1: whole-run drift 1.7-3.6% exceeds this effect; headline comparisons with bc147c5b mean nothing.
interference: No new companion. Fold the queued control's diagnostic into this build: KHALF_ROUNDS=10, route on POOLED over rounds 1-3, print the per-round IQR-fail and ratio<1.03 fractions plus OLD/PARENT/POOLED over triples 1-3, 4-6, 7-9 (~0.7 s); then retire the control.
open_questions: Re-base the pooled KHALF_MAX_IQR: the candidate's true IQR is ~1.42x master's vs a 1.5x bar; a pooled 2.0x bar or p90(cand) < median(master) guards bimodality without failing ~40% of real wins.
Why did the judged m=32 router row not move? If repeated, decide whether router_pdl_ok_32 should route.
Give R-PDL the same median-of-3 rule so its classes do not flicker.
Store raw times in the parent's modified _cell_gate (extra-arm version) for cand and master only; keep R-PDL callers' prints and stats keys.
A scored run's FINAL FLAGS must show pooler_khalf128_ok and all four router_pdl_ok flags.
